{{Quote|I'm just saying, we've been stationed in the Tion Cluster for weeks. At this rate, the war will be over before we see about it.''"<br />"''Wars are not won overnight, Anakin. Master Windu knows what he is doing.''"<br />"''I just wish something exciting would happen around here.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>}}
The '''Tion Cluster''', also known simply as the '''Tion''',<ref name="MtL">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref> was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. An unremarkable part of the galaxy by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was most famous for historically being the home of the short-lived [[Xim's empire|empires]] of [[Xer VIII]] and his son [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].

==Geography==
{{Quote|If Shogar Tok's insurrection is allowed to succeed, we may lose access to the Perlemian Trade Route. Access from here to the Tion Cluster will be impeded.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], to [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], during the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|Battle of Brentaal IV]]|<ref name="JST">''[[Jedi: Shaak Ti]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Tion_Cluster_TEA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Tion Cluster and its surroundings]]
The Tion Cluster was at the edge of one of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] spiral arms.<ref name="MtL" /> Just [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] of the [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster]] was the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] and the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stronghold of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. The [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] passed close to the cluster at [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], and beyond the Tion became known as the [[Far Perlemian]]. Its western border was defined by the line of [[Kanaver]], [[Jhantoria]], [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], and [[Foran Tutha/Legends|Foran Tutha]], while its southern rim was defined by a line from Foran Tutha through [[Saheelindeel]] to [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]]. Its eastern fringe was defined by a line from Dellalt to [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], and its northern border by a line from Raxus to Kanaver. The [[Indrexu Spiral]] was a prominent [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] running from the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]] in the north south through the Tion Cluster.

In the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] carved the Tion Cluster into three [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]: the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]], and the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion]]. Surrounding sectors with [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] influence included the Indrexu sector, the [[Keldrath sector/Legends|Keldrath sector]], and the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]], and were known as the [[Greater Tion]].

The Tion Hegemony was divided into two quite different regions: the cluster of ancient, averagely-wealthy [[Star system/Legends|systems]] at the head of the [[Desevran Trace]] linking it to the Perlemian, known as the [[Livien Worlds]] for their connection to the [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]-era [[Livien League]], and the string of systems beyond the Indrexu Spiral along the [[Tion Trade Route]] known as the [[Back Spiral]], which were mostly poor and had little to do economically or culturally with the Livien Worlds. The Livien Worlds even lacked a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connecting them to the Back Spiral in their sector.

The Allied Tion had little historical identity, having been separated from the Tion Hegemony after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the Empire. Traditionally, this area was a buffer between the Tion Hegemony and Cron, but by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] the Allied Tion was known for its manufacturing and trade: the [[Cadinth Run]] from the Perlemian saw a great deal of traffic, though little of that passed beyond the sector [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]] to the [[Indrexu Route]] and the Desevran Trace.

The Cronese Mandate was by far the largest of the Tion Cluster's sectors, and having been the seat of Xer's [[Kingdom of Cron]], was typically more outward-looking than the rest of the Tion Cluster and typically looked on their neighbors as unsophisticated. Its principal worlds were along the [[Greater Cronese Arc|Greater]] and [[Lesser Cronese Arc]]s; the [[Kismaano Bypass]] and the Indrexu Route connected it to the Allied Tion, while some [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] followed the Arc to Saheelindeel and the worlds of the Tion Hegemony's Back Spiral.

The Tion Cluster contained about 12,000 [[Star/Legends|stars]], orbited by almost 600 habitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Of these 600, 464 were part of the Cronese Mandate. The other 136 were divided between the Tion Hegemony and the Allied Tion sector.<ref name="MtL" />

==History==
{{Quote|My lord, I apologize for intruding on your meditation, but an encrypted Jedi code transmission has been picked up and is being monitored in the Tion Cluster.''"<br />"''More survivors of Order Sixty-Six.''"<br />"''Apparently so, my Lord. Shall I summon Lord Vader?|[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Tion_History.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The history of the Tion Cluster]]
The Tion Cluster had inhabited [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlements [[Pre-Republic era|pre-dating]] both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] as well as several planets in the Core Worlds. The Humans were descended from a lost [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ship]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They developed a mixed society with [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] castoffs, and utilized some of their technology to create [[Beam tube/Legends|beam tubes]] circa [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]], and eventually limited [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] that relied upon fixed-position [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacons]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Rakata [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] technology was also present in Xim's [[war-robot]]s.

The limited technology prevented the Tionese from having contact with the Core, eventually forgetting their origins and remaining isolated from the rest of the galaxy. The Tion Cluster achieved galactic prominence in the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[25,053 BBY|foundation]] of the Galactic Republic, when the [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII]] unified much of the cluster in the [[Cronese Sweeps]], carving out the Kingdom of Cron ruled from [[Argai]]. His son, Xim the Despot, completed the conquest with the capture of the Livien League, then began a prolonged [[Xim's Expansionist Period|Expansionist Period]] that expanded [[Xim's empire|his empire]] to the edge of the [[Radama Void/Legends|Radama Void]]. The Tionese, however, soon fell upon [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], resulting in a disastrous [[Xim Wars|war]] that saw the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Xim and shattered the region.<ref name="TEA" />

After Xim's death, much of the Tion Cluster fell into infighting between various successor states, including the Kingdom of Cron, the [[Jaminere Marches]], the [[Keldrath Alignment]], the [[Indrexu Confederation]], and the Thanium Worlds. The Tion Cluster united for one last time to form the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion]] in [[24,000 BBY]] to wage [[Tionese War|war]] against the expanding Galactic Republic, but after a century of fighting, the Tion Cluster surrendered and joined the Republic in [[23,900 BBY]]. Thereafter the Tion Cluster became an unremarkable collection of sectors in the Republic, its Xim-era colonies in the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]] [[The Devouring|devastated]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] in an effort to create a buffer zone between them and the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

In the Republic's final [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Tion Cluster's disparate states eventually joined up to form two dominions: the Tion Hegemony and the Kingdom of Cron. Both joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] used a communications center on Raxus Prime to broadcast Separatist [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] prior to the conflict.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_1.html|Dooku Spotted in Gree Enclave}}</ref><ref name="DB">{{DB|location|raxusprime|Raxus Prime}}</ref> During the Clone Wars, Dooku built up a [[Dooku's headquarters|secret base]] on the world and hunted the [[Force Harvester]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] on the planet.<ref name="Crossfire">''[[Boba Fett: Crossfire]]''</ref> The [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]], meanwhile, performed its duties on [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]], a heavily fortified world in the [[Raxus system/Legends|same system]].<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

In retaliation for the Tion Cluster's Separatist allegiance, the Galactic Empire divided the area into new sectors after the war, renaming the Kingdom of Cron the Cronese Mandate and carving the Allied Tion, the Indrexu and the Keldrath sectors out of a shrunken Tion Hegemony. The Tion Hegemony was allowed a nominal independence, which was seen as humiliating.<ref name="Xim Week" />

Due to the strategic location of the Tion Cluster's sectors, the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] increased its presence inside the cluster<ref name="TSotFW">''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]''</ref><ref name="MtL" /> and attempted to use the nearby [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] as a forward base to rapidly launch strikes at the Tion Cluster from outside.<ref name="GatORW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], several systems inside the Tion Cluster became battlegrounds between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during [[Operation Strike Fear]].<ref name="SWXW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> Later, some of the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] encountered the notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on [[Panna Prime]], as part of a trap devised by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to track down the Rebel leadership.<ref name="TSotFW" /> After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the entire Tion Cluster was integrated in [[Zsinj's Empire]]. The three sectors stayed under [[Zsinj]] control until [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|his death]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], becoming independent again.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] showed little interest in the region, and talks for re-unification were held in the years after [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] raided the Tion Cluster's border worlds during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy, but did substantial [[Battle of Caluula|damage]] only to the planet [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star cluster of which Dellalt was part of was first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]'', [[Brian Daley]]'s [[1980]] third entry in [[The Han Solo Adventures (omnibus)|''The Han Solo Adventures'']] novel trilogy.<ref name="HLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> It was subsequently identified as the Tion cluster in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', a [[1992]] supplement written by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'',<ref name="MtL" /> and as the uppercase Tion Cluster in the [[:File:NJOmaps_VP.png|map]] featured at the start of the [[1999]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''.<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>
